title: AUDIT-7 Lane 2 slice 4: no-label backlog (490) + promised-follow-up verification sample
body: 490 issues closed in the window carry no labels at all, and 1,898 bodies contain follow-up language ('follow-up', 'separate issue', 'deferred', 'out of scope', 'later'). Tasks: (a) apply the repos' existing label taxonomy to the 490 unlabelled closed issues (type/area labels as the taxonomy provides; note additions on #13878 for Lane 7 coordination); (b) verify a structured sample of the follow-up-language set — every issue whose body explicitly promises a separate/follow-up issue — and file any promised follow-up that does not exist.
